actionConfiguration.body:
INSERT INTO document_items (
    document_id,
    line_no,
    product_id,
    description,
    quantity,
    unit_id,
    unit_price,
    line_total,
    note
)
VALUES (
    {{this.params.documentId}},
    {{this.params.lineNo}},
    {{this.params.productId}},
    {{this.params.description || null}},
    {{this.params.quantity}},
    {{this.params.unitId || null}},
    {{this.params.unitCost || 0}},
    {{this.params.lineTotal || 0}},
    {{this.params.note || null}}
);
